conditions.active: enchantment present and player not holding Shift
conditions.partial_plane: Wear proportional to successful native mining-wear requests; requested exact totals apply to nine requests.

change.summary: Digger keeps one native 3x3 mining batch with a four-point full-plane wear budget, exact 0/1 wear with Unbreaking III, and shared server/client Shift gating.

modifiers.before: BreakEvent recursively mines neighbors whenever enchantment exists, without Shift suppression.
modifiers.after: One native player mining entry captures a batch; active enchantment and no held Shift enable 3x3; Shift or disabled enchantment uses ordinary 1x1 native mining.

modifiers.before: Each native block destroy incurs ordinary tool mining wear, potentially nine for a full 3x3 plane.
modifiers.after: Intercept only normal DiggerItem mining wear on successful removals for this exact player/tool/batch; a complete nine-wear-request plane costs4 without Unbreaking, while Unbreaking III+ costs0 or1 with equal probability (mean0.5). I/II apply vanilla Unbreaking to four-point full-plane budget. Other damage and 1x1 remain vanilla; failed/protected removals do not consume batch mining wear.

modifiers.before: Checks enchantment but does not share Shift state with server area mining.
modifiers.after: Uses same isAreaActive(player) predicate as server: enabled enchantment and no held Shift. Enabled state stays on native item enchantment/NBT synchronization; no new packet or parallel toggle state.

rationale.purpose: Requested 3x3 wear and accurate preview without duplicate mining or durability systems.
rationale.decision_source: User requested this behavior, initially preparation only; subsequent user authorization requests actual local Server and Client application. Implementation seams chosen by Codex.
